quality.review_scope: Independently audited main-text CdTe QD synthesis, purification, characterization and QD-SA conjugation, with Figures 3, 4 and 7. Main pages 1–9 were inspected to verify scope and exclusions. Assay antigen/antibody preparation, assay-only procedures and analytical performance are excluded; SI and cited upstream preparations were not audited. Source conflicts and missing details remain explicit.
missing_fields: Exact reflux time and second-ultrafilter fraction of QD feed; fixed SA concentration, actual conjugation yield and SA loading per QD.
EDC salt form, stock solvents, pH-adjusting reagent and amount; numerical room temperature, shaking speed, storage duration.
No full factorial crosswalk among ratio,pH and dilution series; no conjugate TEM, phase or unit-cell result.
conflicts: p2 uses200uL10uM QDs and later dilution into2.0mL PBS plus0.5mL PBS/BSA yet labels final QD-SA solution8mM; p5 calls20-fold diluted solution0.4mM. Printed concentration labels are retained, not silently corrected.
p2 adds0.5mL PBS with0.5%BSA; p7 discusses conjugate dissolved in1%BSA(m/v) PBS. Distinct statements are retained; equivalence is not asserted.
p3 Methods lists QDs/SA ratios2:1,1:1,1:2,1:3; p5 Figure7a also plots1:4. The figure-only condition is retained separately.
p2 SA feed is inPBS pH7.4; p4 selects coupling reactionpH7.0. These are separate contexts; the adjustment procedure is unreported.
requested_tasks: Different-agent full source audit required before scientific acceptance or publication.
